goal: Track resource nodes that a survivor can harvest and that refill after a cooldown, so two players cannot drain the same node twice in the same second and an exhausted node comes back on its own.
acceptance_criteria: A ModuleScript at src/server/SalvageNode.luau returns a table with Register, Harvest and Remaining functions, all annotated.
An exported type describes a node: its id, what it yields, how much it holds and its refill time in seconds.
Harvest returns how much was taken, which is zero for an exhausted node, and never takes more than the node holds.
A node refills over time from when it was last harvested, computed when it is read rather than on a loop.
Every file begins with --!strict and the whole project passes scripts/verify.ps1.
notes: Keep it small: one module, under 120 lines. A short answer is a correct answer more often.
Return only the files you create. Do not return a file you are not changing.
